name: Claude Seo
description:
Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. Performs full site audits with 11 parallel subagents and 0-100 health scoring across technical SEO (crawlability, indexability, Core Web Vitals, security), content quality (E-E-A-T framework), schema markup (JSON-LD detection, validation, generation), image optimization, XML sitemap
analysis, AI search optimization (GEO for AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity), local SEO  (GBP, NAP, citations, reviews, map pack), maps intelligence (geo-grid ranking, competitor radius), hreflang/i18n, programmatic SEO, and strategic planning. 17 skills,  11 agents. Auto-detects industry type (SaaS, e-commerce, local, publisher, agency). Optional DataForSEO MCP extension for live SERP and keyword data.
longDescription:
Ships **25 skills**, **18 agents** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (25): `seo` (Comprehensive SEO analysis for any website or business type), `seo-audit` (Full website SEO audit with parallel subagent delegation), `seo-backlinks` (Backlink profile analysis: referring domains, anchor text distribution, toxic link detection, competitor gap analysis), `seo-cluster` (SERP-based semantic topic clustering for content architecture planning), `seo-competitor-pages` (Generate SEO-optimized competitor comparison and alternatives pages), `seo-content` (Content quality and E-E-A-T analysis with AI citation readiness assessment), `seo-content-brief` (Generate competitive SEO content briefs with per-section word counts, competitor scoring, keyword density guidance, and page-type templates), `seo-dataforseo` (Live SEO data via DataForSEO MCP server: SERP analysis, keyword research (volume, difficulty, intent, trends), backlink profiles, on-page…), and 17 more
- **Agents** (18): `seo-backlinks` (Backlink profile analyst using free and paid sources), `seo-cluster` (Semantic topic clustering analysis using SERP overlap methodology), `seo-content` (Content quality reviewer), `seo-dataforseo` (DataForSEO data analyst), `seo-drift` (SEO drift analysis agent), `seo-ecommerce` (E-commerce SEO analyst), `seo-flow` (FLOW framework prompt analyst), `seo-geo` (GEO and AI search specialist), and 10 more
- **Hooks** (1): `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-seo@claude-community` from `AgriciDaniel/claude-seo`.
